scope: Read-only audit of current source and recorded validation, 2026-10-16

status_meaning.supported: Implemented and exercised within explicit resource limits; not proof of full reference compatibility
status_meaning.partial: Material limitations inside this family or substantial conformance gaps

evidence_basis: Rust parser/compiler unit tests; generated-C assertion fixtures and runtime C checks under ASAN/UBSan; converter/validation.json recorded runs. No new tests executed for this read-only audit.

features.name: Comments and quoted/long literals
features.limits: Line comments, long bracket comments/literals and documented control escapes are parsed. String value restrictions are counted separately.

features.name: ASCII and P8 glyph identifiers
features.limits: Glyph identifiers parse and generated C names are encoded. Accepts a broad set of non-ASCII characters rather than validating an exact reference identifier alphabet.

features.name: Nil, booleans, truth and equality
features.limits: Tagged nil/number/boolean/string/table/function values; zero is truthy. No separate independent PICO-8 oracle.

features.name: 16.16 numeric literals and arithmetic
features.limits: Leading-dot decimal/hex/binary literals, malformed-radix rejection and wrapping fixed arithmetic exist. Hex fractions remain limited to4 digits, binary to16 and whole radix text to u32. Decimal rounding, restricted power ranges and libm fidelity remain partial.

features.name: Expression evaluation and short circuit
features.limits: Emits temporaries in source order, and/or retain operand values and short-circuit effects.

features.name: String values, concatenation and byte encoding
features.limits: P8SCII byte indexing with positive/negative positions and empty out-of-range reads is tested, alongside roundtrips/long strings. Strings carry explicit lengths, so NUL bytes from escapes and chr(0) are preserved. Strings max 8191 bytes, arena 32KB/768 slots. Fractional/non-numeric index coercion and glyph fidelity are not fully modeled.

features.name: Local/global/parallel/compound assignment
features.limits: RHS temporaries, indexed destinations and one-time compound indexed evaluation tested. Expression-list limit is counted separately.

features.name: Lexical blocks, locals and shadowing
features.limits: Stacked scope maps and boxed captured locals. Semantic assertion fixtures cover shadowing and module captures.

features.name: If/elseif/else and PICO-8 short statements
features.limits: Normal and same-line conditional/while forms plus ? shorthand print parsed; no exhaustive reference syntax suite.

features.name: Numeric for, while, repeat and break
features.limits: Numeric fixed-point iteration, reverse steps, repeat scope and runtime budget exist.

features.name: Named/anonymous/local functions and first-class calls
features.limits: Generated native C functions dispatch through function-tagged values; recursion and callbacks asserted, call depth capped32.

features.name: Mutable lexical captures and closure lifetime
features.limits: Shared mutable cells, sibling and factory isolation, recursion, closure/table cycles and frame-boundary retention tested. Max64captures/closure,1024cells,256closures,2048capturelinks.

features.name: Multiple return expansion and scalar parentheses
features.limits: Final-call and vararg expansion in assignments/args/return/table tails and native builtin result lists tested. Lists hold up to 64 fixed values; a final expansion adds at most 16 at a call site and results are limited to 32.

features.name: Table functions and colon method syntax
features.limits: Method self insertion and receiver-once evaluation tested, including expanded tail arguments.

features.name: Array/record/mixed tables and identity
features.limits: Dynamic keys, nil deletion and identity exist within bounded pools; max512tables/3072entries. Metatable semantics separate missing family.

features.name: Built-in all/pairs/ipairs and foreach
features.limits: Direct generic-for built-ins, including all+del shift handling, plus first-class all/pairs/ipairs/next values through the general iterator protocol.

features.name: Bitwise operators, shifts and rotations
features.limits: Fixed-width operators remain strict for non-number operands. Native bitwise functions separately apply per-operand numeric conversion/zero fallback, with numeric-string behavior using the existing partial parser. No independent oracle.

features.name: Native C code emission and lifecycle
features.limits: Generates C closures, dispatch, _init/_update/_update60/_draw hooks and root enumeration; actual generated code runs under ASAN/UBSan. Not an on-device Lua interpreter.

features.name: Object lifetime and bounded memory management
features.limits: Frame-boundary tracing with string compaction, plus allocation-triggered mid-frame collection that scans native and coroutine stacks conservatively and does not move strings. An explicit grey stack replaces the recursion depth limit. Weak tables are honoured. Fixed pools bound live data.

features.name: Variable arguments (...)
features.limits: Vararg parameters, `...` as a single value, final expansion in calls/returns/assignments, {...} table tails and select("#",...). Expansion obeys the bounded expression-list limits with explicit errors.

features.name: Goto and labels
features.limits: Block-scoped labels lowered to unique C labels per function, visible from nested blocks; forward and backward jumps, continue-style labels and loops. Each goto spends instruction budget. Invalid jumps into a local scope are not diagnosed.

features.name: Custom generic iteration and iterator values
features.limits: Generic for evaluates any explist to an f,s,control triple and calls f until the first result is nil. next, pairs, ipairs and all are first-class values; the direct all/pairs/ipairs fast path remains.

features.name: Coroutine/yield execution state
features.limits: Coroutines run native code on dedicated stacks with x86-64, AArch64 and ARMv6-M context switches; yield works from nested calls and the collector scans suspended stacks. The Pico pool is 4 coroutines of 3 KB; errors inside a coroutine stop the cartridge rather than returning false from coresume.

features.name: Metatables and metamethods
features.limits: Per-table metatables with __index/__newindex (tables or functions), __call, arithmetic, bitwise, __concat, __unm, __len, __eq, __lt, __le, __tostring, __metatable, __pairs and weak __mode tables; rawget/rawset/rawlen bypass them.

features.name: External include preprocessing
features.limits: Comments containing #include are ignored, but real external includes have no resolution or expansion pipeline.

audit_notes: Rechecked optional host instrumentation; no language behavior or capability-status changes. Runtime source locations are file-level references to avoid stale line offsets.

2026-10-16: native builtin multiple-result transport now preserves camera/cursor/clip/select/assert results. New original fixture covers scalar parentheses, aliases, empty tails and callback-result isolation. Existing 16-value bound keeps the language gate partial; varargs remain missing.

Second small-gap pass: string indexing added through value lookup with rawget remaining table-only. tonum/ord result lists share the existing native bridge; language strings and multiple-return gates remain partial.

Third small-gap pass retains numeric partial status while adding exact leading-dot radix literals and malformed-input tests. Native bitwise fallback is distinct from unchanged strict operator behavior; no syntax/arity expansion for omitted bitwise operands is claimed.

Coverage pass (2026-10-16): varargs, goto/labels, general iterators, metatables, coroutines, NUL strings and allocation-triggered collection re-audited with original fixture converter/tests/extended_features.p8 and expected-error scenarios.
